meals.name: Wheatberries, white bean & raw cabbage-carrot bowl with hummus
meals.swaps: swap starch for any whole grain; swap protein for any bean/legume/tofu/tempeh/seitan; swap sauce for any bottled dressing
meals.why: "one of my go-to dinners (and lunches)" -- author's plant-based bowl formula (base + protein + veg + topping + sauce), explicitly built to be swapped
meals.ingredients: wheatberries, cooked 200 g, white beans, canned 150 g, cabbage, shredded 80 g, carrot, shredded 60 g, hummus 3 tbsp

meals.name: Quinoa, tempeh & roasted pepper-onion bowl with sriracha
meals.swaps: swap starch for any whole grain; swap protein for any bean/legume/tofu/tempeh/seitan; swap sauce for any bottled dressing
meals.why: "one of my go-to dinners (and lunches)" -- author's plant-based bowl formula (base + protein + veg + topping + sauce), explicitly built to be swapped
meals.ingredients: quinoa, cooked 200 g, tempeh, pan-seared 150 g, bell pepper, roasted 80 g, onion, roasted 60 g, sriracha 1 tbsp

meals.name: Rice, black beans, lentils & mixed veg plate
meals.swaps: lentils→chickpeas; add fruit on the side
meals.why: diet described as "a steady dose of fruits, vegetables, rice, beans and lentils" that fuelled his shift to ultrarunning
meals.attribution: Trevor Fuchs, vegan ultrarunner, quoted at https://www.runspirited.com/single-post/2020/08/01/vegan-meals-for-ultra-runners
meals.ingredients: white rice, cooked 200 g, black beans 1/2 cup, cooked green lentils 1/2 cup, steamed mixed vegetables 1.5 cups, olive oil 1 tbsp

meals.name: Greens, black beans, brown rice & tahini bowl
meals.swaps: beans→chickpeas; rice→quinoa; add avocado for extra fat
meals.why: "a grain, a green, and a bean" — Frazier's stated lunch formula: big bowl of greens, beans, other veg, topped with a nut-based dressing like tahini; adds whole grains like rice, quinoa or whole wheat bread to make it filling
meals.ingredients: mixed salad greens 2 cups, black beans 1 cup, brown rice, cooked 150 g, shredded carrot 1/2 cup, tahini dressing (tahini, lemon, water) 2 tbsp
